thi-ap29:3.1: sadevakañca passanto vicaranto → sadevakaṁ ca passantā civarantā (bj)
thi-ap29:4.1: hohi → hoti (sya-all) | hohi → sabbā patīhonti (bj: PTS) | hohi → sabbā patī honti (cck: pī.)
thi-ap29:5.2: bhāvanā → bhāvanaṁ (pts) | subhāvitā dīgharattañca no → subhāvitaṁ dīgharattaṁ mayaṁ (pts) | subhāvitā → bhāvanaṁ ca subhāvitaṁ (bj: PTS)
thi-ap29:5.3: dīgharattañca no → dīgharattamidaṁ (sya-all) | no → mayaṁ (bj: PTS) | no → dīgharattamidaṁ (cck: syā. ka.)
thi-ap29:7.4: mahāmuni → mahāmune (bj) | pariccattaṁ mahāmuni → paricattaṁ mahāmune (sya-all)
thi-ap29:8.2: puññampi → puññaṁ hi (bj, pts) | bahuṁ puññampi → bahupuññaṁ hi (sya-all)
thi-ap29:9.1: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all, pts)
thi-ap29:11.2: pabbajimhanagāriyaṁ → pabbajitvānagāriyaṁ (bj) | pabbajimhanagāriyaṁ aḍḍhamāse → pabbajiṁ anagāriyaṁ aṭṭhamāse (pts)
thi-ap29:16.1: yasodharāpamukhāni dasabhikkhunīsahassāni → yasodharīpamukhāni dasa bhikkhunīsahassāni (sya-all); yasovatī pamukhāni dasabhikkhunī sahassāni (pts)
